title: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence orders 20,000 Nvidia GPUs in $4 billion deal
source_used: TradingView copy of a Mint article (published by HT Digital with permission from Mint)
key_facts: AM Intelligence (AMI), backed by the founders of Greenko, has placed a binding order for 20,000 Nvidia Rubin GPUs worth about $4 billion, according to two people aware of the matter.
The order would supply 70MW of computing power and drive a 100MW expansion across India and Malaysia.
It follows an August deal to deploy 9,000 GPUs at its Hyderabad centre.
AMI says it would operate India's largest operational compute capacity by Q2 2027 once deployed.
An announcement is expected shortly; AM Green, Greenko and Nvidia spokespeople had not replied, and AM Green's Mahesh Kolli declined to comment.
India has 1.2GW of installed data center capacity, expected to reach about 10GW by 2030.
quote_evidence: Greenko founders-backed AM Intelligence (AMI) has placed a binding order for 20,000 Nvidia Rubin graphics processing units (GPUs) in a deal valued at around $4 billion to set up a 70MW capacity, according to two people aware of the development.
An announcement about this will be made shortly.
Queries emailed to spokespersons of AM Green, Greenko and Nvidia remained unanswered till press time.
why_it_matters_hint: India's AI compute build-out is attracting multibillion-dollar chip orders, but this one rests on unnamed sources.
notes: Original is Mint; read the TradingView copy. Mint link not available. Unnamed sources, no company confirmation.
